title: Devops
description:
Sobre a Techlead

Na Techlead, impulsionamos avanços digitais em nossos clientes unindo o poder da inteligência artificial e cibersegurança à precisão da engenharia de software para construir soluções únicas cada vez mais inovadoras e prontas para o ambiente corporativo. Mais que acelerar o crescimento dos negócios , com apoio de tecnologia de ponta, maximizamos a eficiência operacional. Estamos expandindo nosso time de engenharia de software e buscamos um(a) Analista de Configuração Pleno (DEVOPS) , que seja proativo(a) e esteja alinhado à nossa cultura de agilidade, colaboração, alta performance e eficiência.

Sua missão

Você fará parte do nosso time de infraestrutura, contribuindo com sua visão e habilidades na construção de soluções que resolvam problemas reais de grandes clientes, participando de projetos que causarão impactos positivos à sociedade. Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Automatização de Processos: Desenvolve e implementa ferramentas e scripts para automatizar tarefas repetitivas, como integração contínua, entrega contínua e testes. Isso ajuda a reduzir erros humanos e acelerar o processo de desenvolvimento.
  • Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua (CI/CD): Configura e gerencia pipelines de CI/CD para garantir que o código seja continuamente integrado, testado e entregue de maneira rápida e confiável.
  • Gerenciamento de Configuração: Utiliza ferramentas de gerenciamento de configuração para garantir que a infraestrutura e os ambientes de desenvolvimento estejam consistentes e configurados corretamente.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementa e mantém sistemas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho e a saúde das aplicações e da infraestrutura. Isso ajuda a identificar e resolver problemas proativamente.
  • Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura: Trabalha com infraestrutura como código (IaC) para provisionar e gerenciar recursos de maneira eficiente.
  • Colaboração e Comunicação: Facilita a colaboração entre as equipes de desenvolvimento e operações, promovendo práticas e uma cultura DevOps que favoreçam a comunicação e a colaboração entre essas equipes.
  • Segurança: Integra práticas de segurança desde o início do desenvolvimento (DevSecOps), garantindo que a segurança seja uma parte integral do ciclo de vida do software.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Diagnostica e resolve problemas de desempenho e falhas em ambientes de produção, muitas vezes trabalhando em conjunto com desenvolvedores e engenheiros de sistemas.
Quem buscamos

Para embarcar nesta jornada conosco, é necessário:

  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em funções relacionadas a DevOps ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Desejável: Certificação em Segurança da Informação (CompTIA Security+, CISSP), Certificação em Metodologias Ágeis (Scrum Master, PMI-ACP), Idiomas: Inglês intermediário.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Deploys de Middleware em OpenShift, Segurança em Middleware e OpenShift, Certificações: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Docker Certified Associate (DCA), Azure DevOps Engineer Expert.
Sua atuação

Esta é uma oportunidade com necessidade de atuação híbrida.

Nossos Benefícios

  • Plano Médico e Odontológico Bradesco TOP Nacional: Cobertura integral para o colaborador, com possibilidade de inclusão de dependentes mediante desconto em folha.
  • Auxílio Creche: Para crianças do 4º mês até 1 ano de idade.
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição: Via Flash benefícios.
  • Uber Business: Para deslocamentos relacionados ao trabalho.
  • Day Off de Aniversário: Um dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário.
  • Licença Alura e Incentivo a Certificações: Visando o desenvolvimento profissional, sujeitos à disponibilidade e critérios específicos.
  • Vale Transporte: Para colaboradores com atividades presenciais.
  • Auxílio Home Office: Via Flash benefícios.
  • Férias & Co.: Um incentivo pensado para o lazer dos seus sonhos.
Por que se juntar a nós?

Oferecemos uma oportunidade única de atuar colaborativamente em uma equipe de alta performance composta por pessoas distribuídas em diversos estados brasileiros. Apoiar grandes empresas e o setor público a serem mais eficientes, atuando em uma empresa que valoriza a inovação, a excelência e o crescimento profissional. Além de um pacote salarial competitivo, você terá a chance de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores, com tecnologias modernas, uma equipe motivada e um ambiente que apoia o seu desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal.

Está pronto para ser um agente de transformação na Techlead? Junte-se a nós e vamos escrever juntos essa história. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Main responsibilities

  1. Revisar e validar documentos relacionados às operações de comércio exterior, como faturas comerciais (Commercial Invoice), Packing List, Certificados de Origem, Declaração Única de Exportação (DUE) e Cartas de Crédito, garantindo a precisão e conformidade com as exigências legais e contratuais.
  2. Coordenar a emissão de documentos adicionais, como Certificados Fitossanitários, Certificados de Conformidade e Certificados de Seguro, quando aplicável.
  3. Realizar o monitoramento de processos de exportação junto aos despachantes aduaneiros, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos.
  4. Resolver pendências ou exigências fiscais e aduaneiras, minimizando atrasos e custos adicionais.
  5. Atualizar o sistema interno com as informações de status dos processos de desembaraço.
  6. Desenvolver estratégias de transporte internacional, considerando modais marítimos, aéreos, rodoviários e ferroviários, para otimizar custos e prazos.
  7. Negociar contratos e tarifas com agentes de carga, transportadores e operadores logísticos.
  8. Monitorar o rastreamento de embarques e desembarques, garantindo a integridade e segurança das mercadorias durante o transporte.
  9. Realizar análises detalhadas de custos, incluindo fretes internacionais, taxas portuárias, impostos, seguros e despesas operacionais.
  10. Elaborar cálculos de formação de preço de exportação, considerando margem de lucro e competitividade no mercado global.

WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we’re on a mission to deliver a better way to pay and get paid. Consumers deserve a payment option that prioritizes financial responsibility, and merchants should have the independence to accept payments without unnecessary costs. This mission drives everything we do.

We’re revolutionizing the payments industry by making Pay by Bank the new standard at checkout, providing a smarter payment option to credit and debit cards. For merchants and consumers, this means the freedom to make and receive payments with greater security and ease.

Fueled by this purpose, we’ve grown into a global network connecting 9,000 merchants to 650 million consumers through 12,000 banks across 33 countries, processing over $58 billion annually. As the leader in Pay by Bank, we aim to redefine the payments experience by delivering exceptional products and unmatched value.

With regional offices in Vitória, Brazil and Silicon Valley, USA, and our global headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, we are a diverse team that spans over 30 nationalities. Embracing a culture of innovation and collaboration, our 'work from anywhere' policy allows employees in Brazil, the U.S., and Canada to work remotely within their country of residence, enabling flexibility while staying connected to our global team.

At Trustly, we believe that inclusion and diversity are essential foundations for building a fair and equitable society. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, ancestry, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, or disability status. Our main goal is to provide a fair, welcoming, diverse environment with opportunities for all collaborators. The stages of our selection process take place online and without distinction of any kind.

Now is the perfect time to join us and help accomplish our mission. If you’re inspired by purpose, thrive in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment, and are ready to shape the future of payments, we’d love to hear from you!

About the team

We are a fintech, so technology is the most important part of our product! Product engineering teams are primarily responsible for keeping Trustly running and ensuring that we can continue to grow at an accelerated pace. We are the guardians of business rules and integrations with our partners. When we are not directly responsible for this, we provide an interface with the necessary information for other teams to do.


What you'll do:

  • Autonomously analyze huge volumes of data and logs, take part in complex issue investigations and to recognize if the system is performing as expected.

Who you are:

  • Solid knowledge and experience with Java;
  • Solid knowledge of software engineering concepts;
  • Solid knowledge of relational and/or non-relational databases;
  • Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Javascript;
  • Have ownership and focus on solutions;
  • Ability to work with remote and international teams;
  • Ability to communicate clearly and objectively;
  • Advanced English - you do need to feel comfortable participating in a meeting.

Our perks and benefits:

  • Bradesco health and dental plan, for you and your dependents, with no co-payment cost;
  • Life insurance with differentiated coverage;

  • Trustly Club - Discount at educational institutions and partner stores;
  • English Program - Online group classes with a private teacher;
  • Extended maternity and paternity leave;

  • Flexible hours/Home Office - our culture is remote-first! You can work in every city in Brazil;
  • Welcome Kit - We work with Apple equipment (Macbook Pro, iPhone) and we send many more treats! Spoiler alert: Equipment can be purchased by you according to internal criteria!;

Join Novibet as a Senior DevOps Engineer at our Brazilian HQ in São Paulo !

Are you ready to take on a key role in a dynamic, fast-growing company? If you have a passion for DevOps Engineering and thrive in a fast-paced environment, this could be the right opportunity for you.

Who We Are

Founded in 2010, Novibet is a leading GameTech company with a strong international presence. We operate in diverse markets, including Greece, Cyprus, Ireland, Canada, Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Ecuador, Finland, Italy, and New Zealand. With offices in Greece, Malta and Brazil, our mission is to deliver unparalleled sports betting and online gaming experiences to our rapidly expanding customer base.

Why Novibet

At Novibet, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work, consecutively from 2021, reflecting our commitment to developing a positive, inclusive, and supportive work environment. Join us, and you will be part of a team of over 1,000 people worldwide that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

What We are looking for

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior DevOps Engineer with a passion for automation, continuous integration, and cloud infrastructure. If you enjoy problem-solving, you are detail-oriented and have a mindset of continuous learning and improvement and are passionate about driving innovation through DevOps best practices, we’d love to hear from you!

What you will work on

  • Plan, build and maintain our infrastructure and always be on a constant lookout to improve our environment
  • Work closely with developers to create and improve deployment strategies and pipelines
  • Closely monitor our existing infrastructure and act if any abnormalities are found
  • Create and maintain documentation of our internal systems
  • Develop and maintain solutions for operational administration, system/data backup, disaster recovery, and security/performance monitoring
  • Deploy applications via automation with configuration management tools
  • Help define, document, evolve, and evangelize high engineering standards and best practices across multiple areas

What you bring

  • 3-5 years of experience in a DevOps or related role
  • Advanced expertise in Microsoft and Linux server administration
  • Proficient in version control using Git and GitFlow development models
  • Hands-on experience with configuration management and orchestration tools (e.g., Ansible, Chef, Salt, Puppet)
  • Skilled in building, administering, and managing CI/CD pipelines using tools such as TeamCity or Jenkins
  • Strong experience with cloud infrastructure on platforms like Azure, AWS, or GCP
  • Solid understanding of database technologies (e.g., MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • Proficient in infrastructure-as-code using Terraform
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure monitoring tools (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus)
  • In-depth knowledge of containerization technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, AKS, Docker, OpenShift)
  • In-depth knowledge of kubernetes technologies (Helm, ArgoCD, AKS, Trafeik)
  • Strong networking fundamentals
  • Experience working with virtualized environments
  • Proficient in at least one scripting language (e.g., BASH, Python, PHP, Go)
  • Experience with log management and monitoring tools (e.g., ELK Stack, Splunk)
  • Experience with developing github actions
  • Familiarity with deployment strategies and tools (e.g., Ansible, Github Actions, ArgoCD, Octopus Deploy)
  • Knowledge of message queueing systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ)
  • Understanding of in-memory data storage systems (e.g., Redis, Memcached)
  • Knowledge of web server and load balancer technologies (e.g., NginX, HAProxy)
  • Professional proficiency in English, verbal and written

What we offer

We truly value our people at Novibet! Within our vibrant, dynamic, and fast-paced environment, we encourage everyone to reach their full potential while enjoying every step of the journey. Here’s how we make that happen:

title: Carbon Markets Policy Specialist
description:
We are looking for a Carbon Markets Policy Specialist to join our Carbon Markets Policy & Guidance team. The team tracks organizations and governments seeking to shape private sector responses to climate change and the development of the carbon credit market on the path to net zero. This vacancy is for an experienced researcher to join our team and take the lead on carbon market policy research in Latin America.

About the role:

This role will take a leading role on the continued development of MSCI Carbon Markets policy analysis, with a particular focus on the Latin America region. The Carbon Markets Policy Specialist will also be involved in collating qualitative and quantitative data to track organizations, investors and governments seeking to shape corporate responses to climate change and the use of carbon credits.

Key to success in this role will be the ability to generate concise insights from disparate sources of information, covering emerging or fast-moving policy areas and complex standards, reports, and regulations.

The role will be based in São Paulo, Brazil.

Responsibilities will include:

  1. Analysis of national and subnational climate and carbon market policy in a range of countries, including conducting interviews and preparing country profiles.
  2. Tracking developments in international policy and standards relating to climate change, net zero and the voluntary carbon market.
  3. Qualitative and quantitative research across the policy areas covered by the team.
  4. Thought leadership on carbon markets and climate policy, with a focus on Latin America.
  5. Supporting MSCI’s COP30 strategy and policy engagement in the region.
  6. Communicating insights internally and externally, delivered to clients through client meetings and conferences, plus monthly reporting, an online platform, webinars and other research projects.

Successful candidates will have research, advisory or public policy experience relating to climate policy, carbon markets, or corporate climate strategies. This may have been gained through experience with research firms, governments, consultancy, corporate or investor sustainability teams, project developers, think tanks, NGOs, or academia.

Candidates should have a strong team ethic, excellent written communications skills, and be capable of extracting insights and communicating them with clarity to senior-level audiences.

Qualifications and experience:

  1. Degree in Environmental Studies, Climate Change, Public Policy, or a related field. Post-graduate degree preferred.
  2. At least 5 years’ experience from the public, private, financial or NGO sectors relating to climate change, net zero, or carbon markets.
  3. Experience with national climate policy or international climate negotiations is particularly welcomed.
  4. Excellent communication skills in English and Portuguese. Communication skills in Spanish would be a distinct asset for this role.
  5. Proven responsibility for delivering reports, briefings, or other written outputs.
  6. Presentation skills to clearly articulate ideas and facilitate strong relations with a global team of carbon and climate research analysts, technology and operations teams.
  7. Knowledge across various climate policy issues, with the ability to extract insights and communicate complex issues to senior-level audiences.
  8. Demonstrable enthusiasm for addressing climate change in the corporate and financial sectors.

This role is for you if you are:

  1. Aware of what a corresponding adjustment is and actively interested in Article 6 debates.
  2. Inquisitive, analytical, and naturally inclined to ask, ‘But what does this mean?’, ‘So what?’ and ‘What happens next?’
  3. Comfortable both writing a 20-page report and summarizing a new policy development in a sentence.
  4. Collaborate generously with your teammates but effective at working independently.
  5. Are passionate and pragmatic about how the world can tackle the climate challenge.

What we offer you:

  1. Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
  2. Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
  3. A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
  4. A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
  5. Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our platform, LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
  6. Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
  7. We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our purpose – to power better investment decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.

MSCI is a leading provider of critical decision support tools and services for the global investment community. With over 50 years of expertise in research, data, and technology, we power better investment decisions by enabling clients to understand and analyze key drivers of risk and return and confidently build more effective portfolios. We create industry-leading research-enhanced solutions that clients use to gain insight into and improve transparency across the investment process.

title: -Revenue Operations Manager
description:
Overview

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Revenue Operations Manager to oversee and optimize our revenue operations (RevOps) processes and technology stack . This role will support Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support teams by ensuring seamless system functionality, driving process improvements, and managing the end-to-end execution of RevOps initiatives.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment , has a deep understanding of lead flow and attribution , and takes full ownership of tasks, projects, and the RevOps roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Stack Management

  • Maintain and optimize the RevOps tech stack (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, Pandadoc ) to minimize disruptions across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support teams .
  • Ensure software updates and package management to keep systems current and secure.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system bugs in a timely manner, prioritizing critical issues.
  • Implement necessary workflow, form, and field modifications as needed.
  • Evaluate and implement new RevOps tools to enhance operational efficiency.

Testing & Deployment

  • Test changes in sandbox environments , deploy updates to production, and validate post-deployment functionality.
  • Conduct lead flow testing to ensure RevOps changes do not disrupt demand generation and sales processes.

Project Ownership

  • Manage and maintain the RevOps Roadmap Jira board , ensuring priorities align with stakeholder feedback.
  • Lead weekly RevOps sprint planning sessions and provide actionable insights.
  • Oversee large-scale RevOps projects , such as implementing Pandadoc for order management .
  • Own RevOps reporting that requires integrations across platforms (e.g., Zendesk, HubSpot, VWO, and Salesforce ).

Process Optimization & Documentation

  • Develop a deep understanding of lead flow processes and attribution models (e.g., why a lead is categorized as "Other" vs. another channel).
  • Document the RevOps tech stack , outlining each vendors purpose and function (e.g., in a spreadsheet or similar format).
  • Identify and implement opportunities for process improvements in revenue operations.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a related role , with hands-on expertise in HubSpot, Salesforce, and Pandadoc .
  • Strong technical aptitude , with the ability to troubleshoot bugs, manage integrations, and update software packages .
  • Exceptional attention to detail and experience with testing and deploying changes in a production environment.
  • Deep understanding of lead flow, attribution models, and CRM systems , with the ability to explain complex processes clearly.
  • Self-starter with a proactive mindset , able to work independently.
  • Familiarity with Jira or similar project management tools is a plus.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively across Marketing, Sales, Success, and Support teams .
  • Experience creating detailed documentation or spreadsheets mapping tech stack components and their functions.
  • Passion for analyzing and optimizing lead flow processes to enhance revenue operations.

If you are an analytical, tech-savvy professional with a passion for revenue operations, we would love to hear from you!

  • Estudar, aplicar e evoluir metodologias de atribuição e modelos estatísticos para avaliação de performance.
  • Apresentar estudos, relatórios, projetos e testes para clientes internos e externos.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e implementação de taxonomias para campanhas de mídia.
  • Interpretar dados de pesquisas de brand lift e mercado para gerar insights acionáveis.
  • Implementar e acompanhar soluções de monitoramento de marca, concorrência e produtos.
  • Mapear e estudar dados de mercado, público, concorrência e canais para enriquecer planejamentos de marca, campanha e mídia.


Requirements and skills

  • Experiência de 2+ anos com dados de mídia, social, comunidade, creator, comunicação, marca e pesquisa.
  • Conhecimento avançado das principais ferramentas de compra de mídia digital (Meta, Google, TikTok, DV360, etc.) e Google Analytics.
  • Domínio de conceitos e práticas de modelagem e transformação de dados (ETL), especialmente voltadas para campanhas de mídia e performance.
  • Experiência na aplicação de metodologias de dados para análise e geração de insights.
  • Experiência em analisar jornadas omnichannel e mapear oportunidades de conversão em funis de aquisição e retenção.
  • Experiência com integradores de dados e ferramentas similares.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência na condução e aplicação de testes A/B.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas como Stilingue, Tagger, Supermetrics e Looker Studio.
  • Experiência com dados de mídia offline (TV, OOH, DOOH) e conhecimento em metodologias de mensuração cross-media.
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de manipulação de dados para extração e análise de informações.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de dados com atualização em ou quase em tempo real, garantindo agilidade na tomada de decisão.

title: Senior Analyst, Customer Operation
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build asustainableeconomy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactionssecure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior Analyst, Customer Operation osition Title: Senior Analyst, Customer Operations
Who is Mastercard?
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
Overview
The Ethoca Customer Experience & Engagement team is looking for a Senior Analyst, Customer Operations to help drive our operational excellence and customer experience strategy forward. This customer-facing position plays a key role in supporting customer operations, contributing to process improvements, and driving initiatives that ensure Ethoca’s services are delivered according to our best-in-class standards.
Our ideal candidate is a problem-solver who takes initiative, feels comfortable making decisions, and contributes actively to cross-functional projects. You’ll be a bridge between customers and internal teams, with opportunities to lead initiatives that improve both customer outcomes and operational performance.
Role
Support live customers with account updates, escalations, and operational inquiries
Own and drive customer-facing and internal operational projects
Participate in process reviews and propose improvements
Act as a conduit between internal and external stakeholders, managing expectations and resolving competing priorities
Develop expertise on internal tools, support processes, and onboarding journeys
Act as the subject matter expert for Ethoca's customer-facing tools and services
Facilitate customer-facing refresher training sessions when needed
All About You
Strong English communication skills (written and verbal)
Comfortable interacting directly with customers and understanding their business needs
Capable of independently driving tasks and decisions while balancing cross-team collaboration
Experience supporting API/SFTP B2B technology solutions, ideally in fintech or SaaS environments
Analytical and detail-oriented, with a passion for solving problems and optimizing workflows
Have the flexibility to support international time zones for our global customer support
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities
Nice to Have
Intermediate Spanish proficiency
Experience with automation tools, RPA, or Microsoft Copilot
Familiarity with tools such as Postman, JIRA, Splunk, Azure, SQL
Prior knowledge in Fraud & Chargebacks or payment industry solutions
Encouraging Diverse Applications
At Mastercard, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We encourage all candidates, especially women and individuals from underrepresented groups, to apply—even if they don’t meet every single requirement listed. Studies show that women are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet 100% of the criteria. We value potential and a growth mindset just as much as experience.

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Comprador direto e indireto
description:
O Comprador indireto será responsável por obter, negociar e comprar bens e serviços indiretos, incluindo material de escritório, equipamento de TI, serviços de manutenção e itens de instalações, uniformes, EPIs (equipamentos de proteção individual), ferramentas e outros itens consumíveis.
Essa função envolve trabalhar em estreita colaboração com vários departamentos para entender suas necessidades, gerenciar relacionamentos com fornecedores e garantir a conformidade com as políticas e orçamentos da empresa, além de garantir que o material/serviço seja entregue com base no pedido de compra, dando suporte a todos os departamentos.


PRINCIPAIS DEVERES

  1. Integrar o fornecedor, solicitar detalhes do fornecedor para configuração e enviá-los por meio do processo interno.
  2. Identificar e avaliar fornecedores para bens e serviços indiretos. Negociar contratos e preços para obter um bom valor para a organização.
  3. Solicitar cotação aos fornecedores, analisar os preços e termos de pagamento, garantindo o alinhamento com as condições pré-estabelecidas e validar ou enviar para um novo processo de aprovação com evidências apropriadas.
  4. Revisar as requisições com clareza e precisão, obter a cotação e prosseguir com as requisições para o pedido de compra indireto.
  5. Coordenar o fluxo de trabalho de aprovação do pedido de compra e garantir que todas as partes apropriadas envolvidas o aprovem antes de enviar o pedido de compra ao fornecedor.
  6. Enviar o pedido de compra aos fornecedores locais e internacionais com base nas requisições internas.
  7. Monitorar POs vencidos ou parcialmente recebidos para garantir que todos os itens sejam recebidos antes do pagamento.
  8. Gerenciamento de fornecedores, construir e manter relacionamentos com fornecedores para garantir entrega, serviço e conformidade com os acordos contratuais.
  9. Recebimento e validação de faturas com pedido de compra para encaminhá-lo à equipe de estoque e/ou equipe de logística.
  10. Liderar negociações com fornecedores sobre questões relacionadas a discrepâncias em quantidades, preços e outras condições.
  11. Manter o banco de dados organizado, atualizar a documentação e alcançar.
  12. Colaboração multifuncional, trabalhando com as partes interessadas internas para entender suas necessidades de aquisição e fornecer soluções oportunas.
  13. Fornecer atendimento ao cliente para as partes interessadas internas e externas para garantir assistência adequada na aquisição e entrega de bens e serviços necessários.
  14. Pesquisa de mercado, manter-se informado sobre tendências de mercado e estratégias de preços para tomar decisões de compra informadas.
  15. Gestão de orçamento, monitorar e gerenciar gastos contra restrições orçamentárias, garantindo eficácia nas decisões de compra.
  16. Identificar oportunidades de eficiência de processos e implementar as melhores práticas em aquisição.
  17. Monitoramento de KPI.
  18. Dar suporte a auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências, documentação e informações solicitadas, bem como fornecer quaisquer explicações necessárias.
  19. Atuar como multiplicador de conhecimento, fornecendo suporte técnico aos pares.

Escopo direto

  1. Enviar a ordem de compra aos fornecedores locais e internacionais com base na demanda para evitar escassez e excesso.
  2. Gerenciar o processo da cadeia de suprimentos, incluindo a colocação do pedido, rastreamento e acompanhamento até o recebimento do material do depósito.
  3. Comunicar-se com o fornecedor sobre entrega antecipada, problemas de estoque e itens alternativos aprovados quando necessário.
  4. Sourcing e aquisição, identificar, avaliar e selecionar fornecedores para materiais diretos, garantindo o alinhamento com as necessidades de produção e os padrões da empresa.
  5. Gestão de relacionamento com fornecedores, desenvolver e manter relacionamentos fortes com fornecedores para garantir qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho.
  6. Gestão de estoque, monitorar os níveis de estoque de materiais diretos, prever necessidades para evitar escassez ou situações de excesso de estoque.
  7. A colaboração multifuncional trabalha em estreita colaboração com as equipes de logística, produção, engenharia e garantia de qualidade para entender os requisitos e especificações de materiais.
  8. Garantia de qualidade, garantir que todos os materiais adquiridos atendam aos padrões de qualidade e requisitos de conformidade.
  9. Análise de mercado, manter-se informado sobre tendências de mercado, preços e dinâmica da cadeia de suprimentos.
  10. Manter registros precisos de compras, prazo de entrega, MOQ, preços e informações do fornecedor.
  11. Monitore os principais indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) para avaliar a eficácia.

Mínimo de requisitos

Mínimo de 5 anos especificamente na indústria como uma posição de comprador.
Experiência anterior em compras ou gerenciamento da cadeia de suprimentos, de preferência com foco em compras indiretas.
Fortes habilidades de negociação e comunicação.
Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente entre departamentos.
Fortes habilidades organizacionais e multitarefas.
Conhecimento de tendências de mercado e estratégias de sourcing.
Experiência comprovada em compras diretas ou aquisições em um ambiente de fabricação ou produção.
Fortes habilidades analíticas e atenção aos detalhes.
Familiaridade com gestão de contratos e regulamentações de conformidade.
Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades e cumprir prazos.
Conhecimento do processo de logística envolvendo compras (just-in-time, lead time de fornecimento).
Desenvolvimento e qualificações de fornecedores.

description:
Product Owner Pleno - Trabalho Remoto e Efetivo

Descrição da vaga

O Trizy TSM é um sistema de agendamento (SaaS B2B) que visa melhorar a organização e performance dos principais terminais de carga e descarga do país. Fazemos parte da nstech, a maior empresa de software para logística na América Latina, com um ecossistema integrado de soluções para logística. Nossa cultura valoriza o nosso jeito de SER .

O Trizy TSM integra o ecossistema nstech, a plataforma open logistics mais completa do mundo, construindo o futuro digital do transporte de cargas junto ao setor logístico. Nosso objetivo é impactar positivamente a sociedade, reduzindo poluição, trânsito, mortes nas estradas e custos logísticos, além de promover crescimento econômico, equidade salarial, diversidade e desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional.

Procuramos um Product Owner para atuar na equipe de Sustentação , focado em otimizar e evoluir soluções tecnológicas para o setor de Logística . O profissional será responsável por priorizar demandas, alinhar expectativas com stakeholders, definir requisitos e garantir a entrega de valor contínuo, atendendo aos objetivos de negócio e às necessidades dos clientes.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando histórias e funcionalidades conforme estratégia;
  2. Definir requisitos claros para a equipe de desenvolvimento;
  3. Garantir qualidade e entregas contínuas de melhorias e correções de forma ágil;
  4. Manter relacionamento próximo com stakeholders para entender necessidades e expectativas;
  5. Comunicar status das entregas, prazos e prioridades de forma constante.

Requisitos e qualificações:
  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner ou em funções similares em times de Sustentação;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Conhecimento em processos logísticos (TMS, WMS, Supply Chain, Gestão de Estoque, etc.) é um diferencial.

Informações adicionais:
O que esperamos de você: No Trizy by nstech, valorizamos uma cultura baseada em valores, na qual esperamos que todos vivenciem esses princípios diariamente.

Nossos pilares culturais são:
  • Servir: foco no cliente, humildade, transparência e ética;
  • Equipe: valorizamos trabalho colaborativo e vontade de colocar a mão na massa;
  • Resultados: buscamos agilidade, melhoria contínua, geração de valor a longo prazo e foco em resultados.

Por que fazer parte da nstech?
Temos a visão de ser a plataforma líder em tecnologia para logística e mobilidade, conectando elos e gerando valor para a rede integrada na América Latina.

Atualmente, contamos com uma equipe de mais de 5 mil colaboradores dedicados a melhorar o mundo por meio da tecnologia aplicada à logística e mobilidade.

Estamos comprometidos em gerar impacto social, e buscamos pessoas energizadas e com propósito para fazer parte dessa transformação. Você trabalhará com a maior plataforma de logística da América Latina, em um ambiente altamente colaborativo, com oportunidades de desenvolvimento técnico.

Esta vaga é remota e contratada via CLT, com benefícios como:
- Plano de saúde com baixa coparticipação

description:
Join to apply for the Proposal Analyst role at SSE Brasil - Sirio Solutions Engineering

Join to apply for the Proposal Analyst role at SSE Brasil - Sirio Solutions Engineering

SSE is a multinational company with Italian roots and over 40 years of history, beginning operations in 1984 in the Prato region.

In 2009, we established our presence in Brazil, in the city of Santos, and have since become a trusted provider of engineering solutions and services focused on turbomachinery for the oil and gas sector.

Our services span across mechanical, control and automation, electrical, and instrumentation disciplines, through which we’ve successfully completed thousands of engineering and installation projects worldwide.

Our core business is delivering turnkey engineering solutions , offering tailored services and consulting with a single point of responsibility. We strive to reduce total operating and maintenance costs while enhancing the availability, efficiency, and operational reach of installed turbomachinery fleets, regardless of the original equipment manufacturer.

With this purpose in mind, we install and commission integrated solutions for rotating equipment, auxiliary systems, and process plants—executing both greenfield projects and brownfield upgrades to optimize and modernize mature production assets.

We also provide training, maintenance, after-sales support, remote monitoring, and other value-added services, leveraging cutting-edge digital technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare commercial, technical, and budgetary proposals, considering pricing, feasibility, risk, and cost structure.
  • Monitor and ensure deadlines are met throughout the proposal cycle, from initiation to delivery to the client.
  • Create and manage documentation and reports related to proposals, including technical, commercial, and financial information.
  • Coordinate with engineering, procurement, production, and logistics teams to gather cost estimates, lead times, and required resources.
  • Consolidate cost estimates and define pricing strategies based on established margins and business goals.
  • Participate in internal meetings and occasionally client meetings to align proposal scope and conditions.
  • Support the sales team during contract negotiations when needed.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Control and Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in technical and/or commercial proposals, preferably in control and automation or oil & gas engineering companies.
  • Strong knowledge of cost analysis, pricing, and bid documentation.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel).
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • Experience with platforms such as Petronect, Ariba, or similar tools.

Soft Skills

  • Organization and attention to detail – Essential for managing technical documents, bids, and tight deadlines with accuracy and quality.
  • Analytical thinking – Ability to interpret technical and commercial requirements, assess proposal feasibility, and identify potential risks.
  • Proactivity – Anticipates needs, seeks information from involved departments, and acts independently to ensure timely delivery.
  • Effective communication (written and verbal) – Clarity in drafting proposals, interacting with technical and commercial teams, and presenting information objectively.
  • Teamwork – Works collaboratively with engineering, procurement, finance, and sales in a respectful and integrated manner.
  • Time and priority management – Handles multiple demands simultaneously while meeting schedules and delivery timelines.
  • Resilience and adaptability – Adjusts quickly to changes in scope, deadlines, or client requirements.
  • Results-oriented mindset – Committed to delivering high-quality, competitive, and accurate proposals.

Vem com a gente transformar o dia a dia de milhares de pessoas — com sabor, eficiência e atitude.

Job Description - Application Security Engineer (2507033261W)

Application Security Engineer - 2507033261W

Description

Kenvue is currently recruiting for:

Application Security Engineer

This role is based in Brazil, part of a global team, and reports to the Director,Application & Cloud Security&xDLC.

Who We Are

At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA, AVEENO, TYLENOL, LISTERINE, JOHNSON’S and BAND-AID that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent. Our global team is made up of 22,000 diverse and brilliant people, passionate about insights, innovation and committed to deliver the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means to have the power to impact life of millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours.

What You Will Do

As an Application Security Engineer, you will be safeguarding digital assets and data through advanced cybersecurity solutions and processes. We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Application Security Senior Engineer to join our dynamic team. If you have a passion for identifying and mitigating security risks in applications, working with developers, we invite you to apply and be a part of our dedicated cybersecurity workforce.

Key Responsibilities:

· Conduct comprehensive architecture security reviews of applications to identify vulnerabilities and weaknesses.

· Maintain and operate various security tools SAST, DAST, CWPP, CSPM, SSPM, CASB...

· Perform penetration testing, code reviews, and vulnerability scanning to ensure the security of web and mobile applications.

· Collaborate with development teams to provide guidance on secure coding practices and assist in the remediation of identified security issues, or misconfigurations.

· Develop and maintain security standards, policies, procedures, work instructions and requirements related to application security.

· Stay current with the latest security trends, threats, and vulnerabilities affecting application security.

· Participate in incident response and security incident investigations related to application security.

· Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate security into the technology development lifecycle.

· Automate vulnerability scanning, and compliance checks into development workflows.

· Proficiency in cloud eco-systems such as AWS, GCP or Azure.

· Knowledge of DNS and IP management

· Develop, maintain and run security automation scripts using languages such as python or other software and scripting languages.

· Knowledge of source code systems such as Bitbucket or GitHub.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

Required Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or related field or 5+ years of cyber security experience.

· Advanced English Level (C1 minimum)

· Working experience with application security assessments, vulnerability testing, and secure code reviews.

· Knowledge of web application security vulnerabilities and common attack vectors (e.g., OWASP Top 10).

· Experience with security assessment tools such as Burp Suite, Nessus, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, etc.

· Understanding of encryption technologies, authentication mechanisms, and secure coding practices.

· 5+ years’ experience in software development/engineering with programming/scripting skills in languages like Java, Python, Ruby, or similar languages.

· Experience with roles, processes, and tools to enable a high-performing DevOps practice in an Agile environment.

· Strong knowledge of Kubernetes and containerization (Docker).

· Relevant security certifications such as CISSP, CEH, CompTIA Security+, Azure Security Engineer, and AWS certified – Security Specialty, and Cloud are a plus.

· Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, along with effective communication and teamwork abilities.

· Experience leading a small team and facilitating stand-up meetings.

· Strategic thinking to align security goals with business objectives.

· Experience with Atlassian tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket.

· Knowledge of either Azure or AWS cloud platforms and associated security standards and best practices.

· Strong knowledge of software development tools such as IDEs, security, and code quality tools.

Desired Qualifications

  • Testes automatizados (unitário, integração, E2E, stress)
  • Automação, Integração contínua (CI) e Deploy contínuo (CD)
  • Paradigmas de programação, padrões de projeto e boas práticas
  • Entender os problemas e limitações das tecnologias que trabalha
  • Experiência profissional no desenvolvimento com agentes de IA e sistemas autônomos utilizando modelos de linguagem avançados;
  • Conhecimento em API Gateway (Apigee, Kong)
  • Demonstrar perfil de liderança técnica nos times das soluções back e front-end

Adotamos o modelo 100% remoto, proporcionando flexibilidade, enquanto mantém a interação virtual com a equipe para garantir uma colaboração eficaz e um ambiente de crescimento contínuo.

‘’Se você busca um ambiente de crescimento e desafios, Vem ser feliz’’!

No Luizalabs, temos grande autonomia e responsabilidade, somos multidisciplinares, autogerenciáveis e com pouca burocracia no nosso cotidiano. About Grupo QuintoAndar
Grupo QuintoAndar is the most valuable real estate tech company in Latin America, it was born in Brazil to do something very rewarding: open doors. About Grupo QuintoAndar
Grupo QuintoAndar is the most valuable real estate tech company in Latin America, it was born in Brazil to do something very rewarding: open doors. We opened doors for technology to be part of living. And, through it, we reduce the bureaucracy and simplify the experience of the whole real estate ecosystem, including those renting, buying, and selling homes, as well as real estate brokers, agencies, and other partners of the real estate market.
Together, our leading brands offer solutions covering all stages of the housing journey, namely: Immuebles24 (Mexico), Zonaprop (Argentina), Adondevivier & Urbania (Peru), Plusvalia (Ecuador), ImovelWeb and Quintoandar (Brazil)
Backed by a world-class team of investors and advisors, such as Kaszek, Qualcomm, General Atlantic, and Softbank, QuintoAndar Group is currently valued at over $5.1 billion and continues to grow year-over-year.
To make all this happen, we have more than 3,500 talented people, working with cutting-edge technology and best design practices to ensure a seamless experience throughout the sales and rental process, combined with smart financial products. Here you will work with the best professionals in the market, in an environment that breathes innovation, collaboration, and high performance.
To learn more about our history, visit working at Grupo QuintoAndar:

  • Possibility of constant learning
  • Opportunity to work in a team that seeks to use the best practices and tools on the market;
  • Working in an informal environment with great people who care about each other;
  • Always having new challenges and being encouraged to achieve results that have an impact, always with high quality;
  • Being part of a team working on a high-impact project that affects the lives of thousands of people
Location & Remote Work
Our People Analytics team works on the "remote-first" model, which means we are working from home with the possibility of living anywhere in Brazil. We also have the option of using QuintoAndar's offices in São Paulo or using partner coworking spaces, both up to twice a week.
Language
This job description is written in English because for that position you will need it for communications with coworkers and suppliers who are from worldwide, for tools and internal materials as well. // A descrição desta vaga está escrita em Inglês porque para esta posição é necessário para a comunicação com colegas e fornecedores, que são de diferentes países, além do uso de ferramentas e materiais internos.
Stages of the Selection Process
Our selection process currently lasts an average of 30-40 days, from application to completion of the assessment. Going through:
  • Application & Screening
  • Online SQL Test
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Case Study
  • Leadership Interview
  • Stakeholder Interviews
About the Area:
People Analytics team mission is to support evidence-based decision-making, contributing to more efficient and effective HR practices at QuintoAndar. It is formed by People Data Analysts who work closely with other HR teams to identify patterns and trends, predict future outcomes, and provide actionable insights to enhance employee experience, drive productivity, and align HR strategies with business goals. This open position is specifically designed to work with the Employee Listening theme.
Main Responsibilities:
  • Structure analytical projects by clearly defining problems, tasks, and solutions to support stakeholder strategies and generate actionable insights within the employee listening space (surveys, engagement and climate research, continuous listening, focus groups, online forums)
  • Integrate and analyze data from employee listening space and employee journey processes (Performance Review, Talent Review, Comp & SOP Cycle, Leaves, Absenteeism) to identify correlations, trends, and generate insights for people management
  • Develop a deep understanding of our people's products model and serve as a reference in data analysis tools and techniques (SQL, Python/R, tracking, metrics monitoring, forecasting, clustering, etc.)
  • Support the definition and monitoring of key metrics to achieve departmental goals
  • Apply predictive and prescriptive analytics methods to inform and support decision-making processes
  • Act as an internal advocate for fostering a data-driven culture within the organization
  • Introduce new technologies and techniques that unlock high-impact business opportunities
  • Serve as a key point of contact for the People team and other business areas regarding people data and analytics
Requirements
  • You have experience working with HR Data & Analytics, preferably within the Employee Listening context
  • You are fluent in SQL and at least one programming language for data analysis (e.g., Python, R)
  • You have hands-on experience with Business Intelligence tools such as Tableau, Looker, Looker Studio, Power BI, Superset, or similar
  • You can identify, articulate and solve highly complex problems by leveraging business knowledge, statistical tools, and a data-focused programming language to formulate and validate hypotheses, generate insights, and guide stakeholders in making strategic, data-driven decisions. A high standard of analysis quality is expected, with basic need for managerial validation
  • You are strongly interested in people management topics, particularly in surveys
  • You have good interpersonal and communication skills
  • You have the ability to read materials, produce studies and present them in English
Nice to have:
  • Background in Statistics/Data Science
  • Knowledge of and interest in Psychometrics and Behavioral Sciences
  • Familiarity with research tools such as Medallia, QuestionPro, Qualtrics, and SurveyMonkey

Inovamos e criamos atendendo as necessidades de nossos clientes e do mercado como um todo, nós nos comprometemos com a criatividade, automação, produtividade, bons treinamentos e muito mais. Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Trabalhar com equipes multifuncionais para garantir a qualidade durante todo o ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software (Shift-Left Testing);
  • Elaborar planos e casos de teste (manuais e automatizados), priorizando automações de testes e construção de testes regressivos;
  • Definir prioridades e planejar testes dos requisitos do sistema, estabelecendo prazos que garantam visibilidade das entregas para os demais stakeholders;

  • Identificar oportunidades de automatização de testes e implementar soluções de automação;
  • Implementar estratégias e técnicas de testes ágeis, utilizando referências de mercado e boas práticas;
  • Propor e fornecer métricas de teste/qualidade para acompanhamento do time;
  • Orientar e apoiar no desenvolvimento dos membros da equipe de QA;

Requisitos e qualificações
  • Experiência comprovada como Analista de Qualidade Sênior, com um histórico de sucesso na implementação de testes automatizados e execução de testes funcionais, de aceitação e de regressão em diferentes plataformas e dispositivos;
  • Sólida experiência com controle de versão (Git), testes de integração e cobertura de código;
  • Experiência em frameworks de teste, como Cypress ou Selenium;
  • Experiência em testes de APIs e ferramentas como Postman;
  • Conhecimento em Typescript;
  • Experiência em Integração Contínua (CI/CD);
  • Experiência em aplicação prática de TDD e BDD (Cucumber);
  • Conhecimento sobre Micro serviços e Nuvem.

Por que trabalhar na AT&M:
Nossos pilares de cultura e seus atributos são:
  • Servir: foco no cliente, humildade, transparência e ética;
  • Equipe: é mais importante que o indivíduo, vontade e mão na massa são atributos que valorizamos muito;
  • Resultados: agilidade e melhoria contínua, geração de caixa em longo prazo e foco.

Acreditamos que cultura e pessoas são as duas verticais de maiores vantagens competitivas de negócios vencedores - isso porque, pela sua natureza, é impossível copiar 100% uma cultura, e, as pessoas são a bases de todo e qualquer negócio.

As Marketing Lead for Brazil, you will own the end-to-end marketing strategy and execution for Uber for Business's enterprise offerings.   • Strategic Leadership & Accountability: Define and own marketing ROI and customer acquisition costs for Brazil, setting budgets, KPIs, and targets.

  • Performance Optimization: Lead cross-functional initiatives to centralize performance operations, continuously testing and refining media mixes, attribution models, and automation tools.

  • AI Adoption: Act as the internal AI ambassador, driving AI adoption, coaching peers, and identifying strategic opportunities.
  • Enterprise Field Marketing & CRM: Develop strategies for field marketing and partner with Sales, Finance, and Strategy to ensure smooth launches and long-term client relationships with C-suite executives at Fortune 500 companies.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years in B2B marketing, with at least 3 years leading a team.

Bonus Points
